[[Category: Bombay, sailed 1 August 1842]]
== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born about 1834. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]]. She passed away in 1894.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 84% (probable). An Elizabeth Glasgow was baptised at Manchester Cathedral on 10 July 1842 to Robert Glasgow and Mary, three weeks before the family sailed on the Bombay (1 August 1842). Elizabeth (Glasgow) Hurst is placed in that family by the held account, so the baptism supports her father link modestly, from 79% to 84% probable.

Her birth about 1834 (from later records) fits a late pre-emigration baptism but not a birth in 1842; the baptism index gives no birth date, so it could instead belong to a younger child. Robert's will does not name an Elizabeth. Index transcripts only. No mother change follows.

The dated reviews below describe earlier stages of this research.


=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 ===

In this earlier review, the father [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 79% (probable). The held account assigns Elizabeth (Glasgow) Hurst to Robert Glasgow and Mary Lamb in the Bombay/Turakina family. Elizabeth’s approximate 1834 birth fits the reported sibling group, but the 1894 death index supplies no held parent clause.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Earlier proposed test: Inspect the 1842 Bombay passenger family list and the child’s NZ death certificate parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1860/2685 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages)]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
